title: Notifications do not show on Garmin
body: In the past every time I'd get a new reading I'd get a notification on my Garmin watch.  For some reason this has stopped working.  I've enabled xdrip+ in the Garmin app and the persistent notification does  show in the notification area, but fails to do so on my watch.  I've installed nightwatch as a work around for the time being.

comments.body: I'm not an expert on garmin, perhaps @swissalpine knows how to resolve this?
I get notifications fine on my Fenix 5X.....

Has there been any solution to that problem yet? I've noticed the same thing on my Garmin Forerunner 735XT. I couldn't fix it and switched to xdrip+-watch by Andreas May. However, the watch face doesn't fit my needs like the notifications and it's draining my watch's battery... I'd really appreciate it if anyone could help here... Thanks!
